fc2.title: ALSVID L1 Pro carbon folding e-bike
fc2.description: Meet L1 Pro: a carbon folding frame, mid-drive architecture and four-bar rear suspension. Explore the design, folded format and reference specifications.
fc2.headline: A smaller footprint. A wider world.
fc2.intro: Carbon lines, a compact fold and a drive system at the centre. L1 Pro brings a different expression to the ALSVID folding family.
fc2.gallery.alt.side: Purple L1 Pro reference bicycle, right-facing side profile on a neutral studio background
fc2.gallery.alt.folded: Purple L1 Pro reference bicycle in its compact folded configuration
fc2.gallery.alt.original: Original purple L1 Pro sample photograph showing chain drive and a rear derailleur
fc2.photo.note: Studio images are retouched from genuine sample photographs. The purple sample shows a chain and rear derailleur; it differs from the reference specification below. Images do not confirm a retail finish or specification.
fc2.metric.note: Figures refer to the source model's stated standard configuration. Final ALSVID retail specifications are subject to confirmation.
fc2.story.title: Three systems. One considered frame.
fc2.story.body: Frame folding, rear suspension and electric drive have distinct roles. Understanding each one makes the L1 Pro easier to understand.
fc2.carbon.title: Carbon, with a clear silhouette.
fc2.carbon.body: A 20-inch folding carbon frame and carbon fork define the platform. The main-frame hinge belongs to the folding system; the links behind it belong to the suspension.
fc2.drive.title: Power at the centre.
fc2.drive.body: The reference configuration lists a 250 W DAPU mid-drive, a torque sensor and up to 80 Nm maximum torque. The sensor is specified separately from the motor brand.
fc2.suspension.title: A rear end with its own role.
fc2.suspension.body: Four-bar describes the rear suspension, paired with a DNM air shock in the reference data. It does not describe the frame-folding mechanism.
fc2.fold.kicker: A DIFFERENT SHAPE FOR THE SAME DAY
fc2.fold.title: Ready for a smaller space.
fc2.fold.body: Explore the unfolded and folded sample side by side in the gallery. Reference dimensions describe the stated configuration, not a measured storage guarantee for every build.
fc2.spec.title: Know what is under the surface.
fc2.spec.rear.value: DNM air shock · four-bar rear suspension
fc2.spec.drivetrain.value: Prowheel 64T · Shimano Nexus 3-speed hub · Michelin belt drive
fc2.spec.note: Range, charging time, retail price, delivery date and market compliance are not confirmed here. Options and final retail components require separate confirmation.
fc2.battery.title: The essentials, clearly specified.
fc2.battery.body: A 36 V / 10.5 Ah LG lithium-ion battery and colour LCD are listed in the reference build. A 36 V / 14 Ah upgrade is a project option, subject to compatibility and market review.
fc2.faq.title: A few things worth knowing.
fc2.faq.photo.q: Why do the photographs and drivetrain specification differ?
fc2.faq.photo.a: The available purple sample photographs show a chain and derailleur. The supplied standard data lists a Nexus 3-speed hub and Michelin belt. These are different configurations; neither the photography nor this page confirms the final ALSVID retail build.
fc2.faq.fold.q: Is the four-bar system the folding mechanism?
fc2.faq.fold.a: No. Four-bar refers to rear suspension. The main-frame hinge is a separate folding mechanism.
fc2.faq.buy.q: Can I order L1 Pro now?
fc2.faq.buy.a: This page introduces the new model. Confirmed pricing, available specifications and delivery information will be shown through the official sales channel when available.
fc2.available.title: Meet the new member of the family.
fc2.available.body: L1 Pro joins the ALSVID product family. Explore its reference design today; final sales information will follow through the official channel.
fc2.launch.body: The second folding model: carbon construction, a mid-drive architecture and a distinctly compact silhouette.
